answers.quote: The legislature is not involved in the process of appointment of judges. Thus, it was believed that party politics would not play a role in the process of appointments.

The judges have a fixed tenure. They hold office till reaching the age of retirement. Only in exceptional cases, judges may be removed. But otherwise, they have security of tenure.
